notation: Each field map below is closed: every named field required, no extras. JSON duplicate keys/nonfinite constants refuse. P0 types use current adopted P0. uint means exact int>=0, never bool. Accepted observations require successful complete facts; null/partial diagnostics do not qualify. UTC strings use six fractional digits and Z.

start.json.at: UTC before capture identity/affinity checks and before leases/source-before

source-before.json AND source-after.json.at: UTC sampled after all three source Git queries and inventory/import-root/availability validation
source-before.json AND source-after.json.head: candidate.head after actual rev-parse HEAD equality
source-before.json AND source-after.json.tree: candidate.tree after actual diff-index --cached --quiet equality; NOT HEAD tree
source-before.json AND source-after.json.inventory: flattened ordered candidate input P0 reference list

discovery-command.json.capture_identity: actual capture P0 identity sampled after discovery wait; no separate timestamp field
discovery-command.json.identity: actual spawned child P0 identity|null on failure
discovery-command.json.errors: string list, empty required for accepted discovery

discovery.json.at: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ sampled at collection entry, before dependency commands
discovery.json.argv: nonempty text list; actual /proc/self/cmdline, NOT Python sys.argv
discovery.json.cgroups: nonempty root-to-leaf list of raw-cgroup records
discovery.json.commands: ordered list of closed native-Git or driver command records

raw-device.isolation: nonempty string; accepted current implementation physical-exclusive

driver command.identity: observed driver child P0 identity|null diagnostic

native Git command.executable: sealed native Git P0 reference validated before spawn
native Git command.executable_after: observed post-wait P0 reference; accepted must equal executable; null/changed possible in refused diagnostics
native Git command.identity: actual Git child P0 identity|null diagnostic
native Git command.end: UTC after bounded wait/cleanup and post-reference observation
native Git command.exit_code: observed int|null; known status does not prove pipe EOF
native Git command.stdout: available bytes decoded UTF-8/surrogateescape; partial on failure
native Git command.errors: primary then cleanup/reference errors; empty required for successful mandatory command

additional_files.source-before-git.json: JSON list of native Git command records, execution order. Exactly three successful records for admitted capture. No wrapper object/schema/parent identity field.
additional_files.source-after-git.json: Same list shape/order. A failed source sample retains its list in finally, potentially partial, and no successful source observation.

No implicit PATH or PYTHONPATH insertion into the map. -I ignores Python environment path variables. Reserved key must not be caller-supplied.

identity_and_time_correspondence: P0 identity is {pid,ppid,start_identity,host,boot_id}. start_identity comes from /proc/PID/stat field22; PPID from field4; host from socket.gethostname and boot_id from /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id. It is a process birth token, not a timestamp.

Discovery wrapper.identity equals raw.identity; PID is the actual spawned child PID; PPID equals wrapper.capture_identity.pid. Host/boot equal capture identity and allocation host/boot. Raw argv/interpreter/cwd/profile/TMPDIR/visibility reconcile exactly with wrapper/request. raw.interpreter is resolved sys.executable, no distinct venv invocation/prefix context.

Native Git children in discovery.commands have PPID=raw.identity.pid. Source-before/after Git children have PPID=the capture process PID; join to wrapper.capture_identity.pid. Command host/boot should equal that parent/allocation. Current producer checks actual PID/PPID and /proc/PID/exe; the emitted source JSON does not carry its own capture_identity.

No source observation has identity/start/end fields. Its at is sampled after its three Git commands and source checks. No start.json identity field. wrapper.capture_identity is sampled after discovery finishes, not independently at each source query.

Under non-regressing UTC the emission sequence is: start.at <= before-command0.start <= before-command0.end <= before-command1.start <= before-command1.end <= before-command2.start <= before-command2.end <= source-before.at <= wrapper.start <= raw.at <= each discovery query.start/end <= wrapper.end <= after-command0.start/end <= after-command1.start/end <= after-command2.start/end <= source-after.at <= admission.at. All intervals inclusive; raw.at is collection entry, not completion. Current producer explicitly checks wrapper.start<=raw.at<=wrapper.end and each command end>=start; it does not itself assert the whole cross-file sequence. Consumers can reject clock regression rather than invent timestamps.

All source native query exit codes must be0 and errors empty for admitted capture. Version query must likewise succeed and exactly reproduce dependency.version. CUDA mandatory driver version/inventory/workload queries must succeed; optional topo -m failure may be retained with gpu_topology null and must not be misclassified as a mandatory successful query.

Native capture writes spec.json, admission.json, result.json and the other named files under its new exclusive D. Verify actual referenced bytes/path/size/hash; do not infer hashes from object equality or reconstruct JSON formatting.

Terminal result requires admitted, reasons[], nonnull exact spec/admission refs. result.spec must equal the consumer-supplied exact spec reference; result.admission must equal spec.admission. admission.disposition must be admitted, reasons[] and probe_errors[]. A provisional spec plus missing/refused terminal result cannot qualify.

Candidate/source-freeze and request/source-freeze refs equal spec.source_freeze. Root/path/profile/concurrency/minimum/reserve are copied/bound as described below.

Every admission fact.provenance and each emitted CUDA device.mapping_provenance refers to exact D/discovery.json. Parsing wrapper.stdout must yield the same raw discovery object; stdout JSON formatting differs from the indented discovery file bytes, so compare parsed values after validating both records/references.

Parse ordered worktree lines only; canonical unquoted/unescaped paths required. availability equals ordered {path,directory_exists} observations and candidate.availability.worktrees; actual import-root directory opens and all input refs are checked. These observations do not substitute for root authorization.

Candidate/request/source-freeze authorized roots match. Source-freeze grant refers to root-approved closed source grant; grant root/head/tree/import_roots match candidate; no_writer_barrier and includes_untracked true. Active intervals and grant.start<=freeze.start checked before capture and again before source-after. CPU bound evidence exactly matches each job argv/env/cases/role/source values and accepted evidence set equals used set.

Allocation grant matches host/boot/lease_root and authorized CPU mask; actual capture/discovery affinity must equal its CPU IDs. Root authority string is not proof. Allocation overhead reserves at least one coordinator and root bounds phase peaks. Fixed host-wide pool/allocation/host-timing/device leases and root no-writer namespace custody remain required.

All current capture paths source/output/scratch/lease/D are pairwise disjoint. Capture/output/scratch share filesystem capacity. Exclusive/no-follow creation, directory and held-lock inode checks guard cooperative writes; they do not seal later arbitrary mutation. Current capture code does not continuously supervise source or command files after return.

Required missing facts refuse. Optional absent cpu/numa/gpu topology becomes unsupported with reason. Unlimited cgroup quota/memory uses state unlimited,value null and actual max reason.

raw_to_admission_and_spec.cgroups: Raw path list equals complete contiguous cgroup_root-to-cgroup_leaf ancestry. Parse cpu.max into period>0 and quota>0 or max; cpuset into sorted unique CPU IDs; memory.max into uint or max; memory.current into uint. Admission cgroups closed per P0: path,cpu_quota_us,cpu_period_us,cpuset,memory_limit_bytes. Raw memory.current remains in discovery; admission ram_current_bytes is leaf current.
raw_to_admission_and_spec.cpu: CPU effective visibility empty and devices empty. CPU never imports Torch or queries NVIDIA; optional raw CUDA fields remain null. Inherited visibility may differ because effective visibility is explicitly hidden.
raw_to_admission_and_spec.ram: MemTotal and MemAvailable unique kB lines converted by1024, with 0<total and available<=total. host_ram_bytes=total; limited_ram_bytes=min(total,every finite memory.max); ram_current_bytes=leaf memory.current. Available headroom=min(MemAvailable, max(0,memory.max-memory.current) for every finite ancestor). limited-current is NOT available headroom.
raw_to_admission_and_spec.budget: For admitted complete observations, dimensionwise max(0,min(measured_available,allocation.capacity)-request.reserve-allocation.overhead). CPU/RAM demand is sum of top requested_job_concurrency job budgets. Retained scratch/inodes demand sums all job budgets. Also require minimum and role count+replacement overlap times peak_cpu_slots within each job budget. Missing facts cannot be replaced by allocation declarations.
raw_to_admission_and_spec.dependencies: Actual python_version equals sealed environment.python_version. Sorted-by-name actual dependency inventory equals sealed inventory exactly. Exactly one git dependency: observed full --version line removing only one LF equals version; reference equals native executable. Other dependencies use actual metadata version/origin; torch origin is __init__.py, others unique dist-info/METADATA. CPU does not attest unseen venv distributions or full module closure.
raw_to_admission_and_spec.cuda: Require actual CUDA-capable build/runtime and driver; actual Torch logical UUIDs join driver inventory UUIDs, model and VRAM bounds. Contiguous logical indices, unique authorized physical GPU UUIDs, physical_parent_uuid=gpu_uuid, no MIG, physical-exclusive. Numeric visibility tokens are not driver indices. Full UUID masks preserve exact UUID order. Current driver inventory rejects enabled/unsupported MIG; selected physical GPU competing workloads must be empty.
raw_to_admission_and_spec.spec_copies: spec profile/authorized_root/output_root/scratch_root/lease_root/source_freeze/attempt_id/tools/dependencies equal request; job_concurrency=request.requested_job_concurrency; budget=admission.admitted_budget. Jobs equal request.jobs except CUDA devices replaced by fresh admitted devices only after every non-provenance device field matches. CPU jobs unchanged; job interpreter equals request.interpreter.path and cwd/env/timeout/grace/seed/roles/obligations remain exact.
raw_to_admission_and_spec.cpu_capacity: effective_cpu_capacity=min(cardinality(affinity intersect every ancestry cpuset), every finite quota/period); available cpu_slots=floor(capacity).
